hotels.title: Contemporary Germany Escape near Cologne Cathedral with Onsite Restaurant & Bar
hotels.description: Towering above Cologne's buzzing Gereon neighbourhood, this design-forward hotel is a stone's throw from the city centre and main attractions. Boasting a unique circular design and funky art splashed throughout the building interior, this contemporary retreat is equal parts quirky and stylish, with its retro-futuristc theme making for a captivating stay. With proximity to Cologne's striking Gothic Cathedral and the Romano-Germanic Museum, the city's best is within easy reach. When it's time to treat yourself, NENI restaurant serves up mouthwatering Israeli dishes, while the cool Monkey Bar is the perfect spot to unwind with a drink after days of exploration.
